# awscc_apiportal_product_api_page (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::ProductApiPage



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `api_id` (Attributes) The route (Path + Method) on the source-service resource, resolved from the Managed API's signature. One ResourceArn covers API Gateway, ALB, and CloudFront. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_id))
- `display_content` (Attributes) Three-mode content: write with either Overrides or None; the service populates ApiUrl, OperationName and Body on Read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_content))
- `managed_api_id` (String) Identifier of the Managed API this page documents.
- `product_api_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product API page.
- `product_api_page_id` (String) The product API page identifier.
- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status of the API documentation.
- `status_exception` (Attributes) Reported when Status is FAILED. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_exception))
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product API page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `try_it_state` (String) Whether the interactive TryIt UI is enabled for this API.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product API page was last modified.
